en-US.description: A fast, multithreaded CLI downloader built in Rust.
en-US.name: furl-cli
en-US.releaseNotes:
furl-cli 0.10.0

Added
- One-line install script, similar to rustup/uv:
  curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ghimiresdp/furl-cli/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ghimiresdp/furl-cli/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex"
  Detects your OS/architecture, downloads the matching pre-built binary from the latest GitHub release, and adds it to PATH (idempotently, on repeat runs). Set FURL_VERSION (or $env:FURL_VERSION on Windows) to install a specific release instead of the latest.

Fixed
- furl --version and furl --help used to print Error parsing arguments: ... and exit with code 1 instead of printing cleanly and exiting 0.

Documentation
- Both READMEs (root and crates/furl) now document the install script alongside WinGet/Cargo/from-source/manual-binary options.
- The two READMEs, which had drifted out of sync, are back in sync — the root one was missing the furl config documentation and had a stale, unchecked roadmap item.

What's Changed
- feat: add one-line install script and fix --version/--help exit code by @ghimiresdp in #35
